done_when: When the client has a package.json, the test command forge migrate writes starts with npm ci (the same install forge init's default test uses) before the moved verify commands; a test covers a client with package.json and one without
why: forge migrate moves a client's old verify commands into forge.toml's test without installing the project's dependencies first, so a Node client's CI runs npm checks on a fresh runner with no node_modules (myclaw's migration PR)
